EMS hat 25 Produktionsstandorte in 16 Ländern, beschäftigt weltweit rund 3'000 Mitarbeiter und ist mit rund 140 Lernenden der grösste Berufsbildner im Kanton und Träger des Nationalen Bildungspreises.

EMS-GRIVORY ist Teil des Geschäftsbereichs Hochleistungspolymere der EMS-Gruppe und beschäftigt weltweit über 1000 Mitarbeiter. Das grösste Entwicklungs- und Produktionszentrum befindet sich in Domat/Ems in der Schweiz. Weitere Produktionsstätten liegen in Deutschland, China, Taiwan und den USA.

• Lavorano in IT in un gruppo di sviluppatori e supervisori dei moduli e sono in scambio con gli utenti di potenza dei dipartimenti specializzati.

Cosa porti con te

• Hai una formazione superiore in informatica e/o amministrazione aziendale

• Hai una conoscenza SAP approfondita, preferibilmente hai esperienza nella consulenza SAP

• Ti piace assumerti la responsabilità e risolvere i problemi in modo indipendente

• Essi comprendono i requisiti dei dipartimenti specializzati e possono tradurli nel linguaggio della scienza informatica.

Non vedo l'ora.

• Lavorare nel mezzo di belle aree naturali e ricreative

• Attività emozionanti in un ambiente internazionale con brevi percorsi decisionali

• Un sacco di responsabilità personale e posizioni di gestione attraenti

Informazioni su di noi

Lo SME ha 25 siti produttivi in 16 paesi, impiega circa 3.000 persone in tutto il mondo e, con circa 140 apprendisti, è il più grande formatore professionale del cantone e vincitore del National Education Award.

descriptionByLocale.en:
What to expect

• You are responsible for the stable operation and further development of an SAP module in the area of SD/WM/EWM

• They work in IT in a group of developers and module supervisors and are in exchange with the power users from the specialist departments.

• Your tasks include analyzing user requests, specification for development, customizing, documentation, testing, and coordinating the implementation of changes and fixes.

• In projects you work with or coordinate cooperation and ensure that deadlines are met and the quality is right

What do you bring with you

• You have higher education in computer science and/or business administration

• You have in-depth SAP knowledge, preferably you have experience in SAP consulting

• You like to take responsibility and solve problems independently

• They understand the requirements of the specialist departments and can translate them into the language of computer science.

You can look forward to that.

• Working in the middle of beautiful natural and recreational areas

• Exciting tasks in an international environment with short decision paths

• Lots of personal responsibility and attractive management positions

• Market-oriented remuneration, progressive social benefits and own pension fund with good benefits

• Staff restaurant, free parking

About us

EMS has 25 production sites in 16 countries, employs around 3,000 people worldwide and, with around 140 apprentices, is the largest vocational trainer in the canton and winner of the National Education Award.

EMS-CHEMIE is an internationally successful company specializing in high-performance polymers and specialty chemicals.
The headquarters is located in Domat/Ems, directly next to Chur.
